1.explanation: The ReactModal in src/components/modal/modal.jsx doesn’t disable closing on overlay clicks or mouse events outside the content area. By default ReactModal has shouldCloseOnOverlayClick=true, so releasing the mouse outside the modal content triggers onRequestClose and closes the modal. To fix, we need to add props like shouldCloseOnOverlayClick={false} (and possibly shouldCloseOnEsc={false}) to the <ReactModal> in this file so drags/releases outside won’t close it.
1.bug_scenario: When trimming the sound in the Record Sound modal, if you drag a trim‐handle all the way to the edge and your mouse leaves the modal while you’re still holding down the button, the modal’s overlay “click” handler fires on mouse release and the modal closes (calling onRequestClose). This causes you to lose your recording/trimming work.
